n.description: int, optional, default=1. Order of the difference. Specifies the number of times the difference is computed. If n=0, no difference is computed and input is returned as is.

axis.description: int, optional, default=-1. Specifies the axis along which the difference is computed. The difference is computed along ``axis -1`` by default.

prepend.description: scalar or array, optional, default=None. Specifies the values to be prepended along ``axis`` before computing the difference.

append.description: scalar or array, optional, default=None. Specifies the values to be appended along ``axis`` before computing the difference.

output.description: An array containing the n-th order difference between the elements of ``a``.
